blocks.text: This content includes source-derived contracts for all declared implementation exports from src and libs, a complete TypeScript demo inventory, a WGSL inventory and all original engineering documents. Generated font metric maps and ambient/entry modules are cataloged as data/support modules rather than presented as application tutorials. Public package reachability is recorded independently from source-file existence.

The coverage manifest beside the JSON records the exact file-to-page map for future maintenance. Runtime verification focuses on the newly authored playgrounds; the 277 existing demos and historical notebook sketches are not represented as a fully tested suite.
